title: The Row of Ancestors

steps.prompt: 6 figures stand in a row of numbered chairs, numbered 1 to 6 from the left: the Baron, the Doctor, the Duke, the Heir, the Maid, the Priest. Use the clues, then answer: who stands in chair number 4? (Just the title, like Baron.)
clues: Exactly 4 chairs separate the Maid from the Doctor.
The Maid is somewhere to the left of the Doctor.
The Heir is NOT next to the Baron.
The Heir is NOT next to the Maid.
The Doctor is directly next to the Priest.

reveal_text: The bell tolls and a number is cast into the bronze: 4.
